consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment
integrity of the mechanical seal support system

facts.title: uncontrolled movement of ZV-7210 during a statutory inspection

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage.

defences.finding: Control BUND_AND_DRAINAGE_CONTAINMENT: the secondary containment by bund and drainage had degraded below its design intent, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control EMERGENCY_ISOLATION_ON_RELEASE: the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control SEAL_FACE_TEMPERATURE_ALARM: the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip had been bypassed, and the learning team review classified this as an organisational factor.

Control SEAL_SUPPORT_SYSTEM_INTEGRITY: the integrity of the mechanical seal support system had degraded below its design intent, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the integrity of the mechanical seal support system on ZV-7210 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in managing hydrocarbon transfer and storage, specifically bunding, drainage and spill containment. ZV-7210 (emergency shutdown valves) is in service for jetty and manifold emergency isolation. The task proceeded during a statutory inspection while the secondary containment by bund and drainage had degraded below its design intent. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 28 January 2022 an incident occurred on ZV-7210 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during a statutory inspection, releasing pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator.
